summary: EARTH PULSE is an Environmental Change Intelligence Platform that uses NASA POWER data to analyze environmental trends across selected locations in India. It provides an interactive map for location selection, visualizes temperature and precipitation patterns over time, and uses statistical trend analysis to identify whether environmental conditions are increasing or decreasing. The platform aims to make environmental data easier to understand through interactive graphs and location-based analysis, helping users explore what is changing, where it is changing, and how it is changing.
